name: owner scope (generated.pdf input)
text:
•	Incoming Call Management: Handle all incoming calls and route them to the appropriate department or designated staff member based on the nature of the inquiry.
•	Patient Billing Inquiries: Assist patients with billing-related questions, concerns, outstanding balances, and payment inquiries.
•	Payment Processing: Coordinate and assist with patient payment processing, including collecting payments and addressing payment-related concerns.
•	Active Insurance Coverage Follow-Up: Coordinate with the billing team to contact patients regarding active insurance coverage and obtain updated insurance information when needed.
•	Coordination of Benefits (COB): Assist with COB-related follow-ups by contacting patients to obtain required information and help resolve insurance coordination issues.
Patient Communication & Follow-Up: Ensure patient inquiries are addressed promptly and communicated to the appropriate team for resolution.

name: owner client responsibilities
text:
The Client shall:

System Access: Provide timely and authorized access to the practice management system, electronic health records (EHR), patient billing records, insurance information, payment processing systems, and other necessary platforms.

Call Management: Provide the required telephone lines, call routing instructions, departmental contact information, escalation procedures, and designated staff members for handling transferred calls and unresolved inquiries.

Billing and Payment Information: Ensure that patient balances, payment histories, billing statements, insurance details, and account information are accurate and regularly updated. Provide approved payment processing methods and clearly defined policies regarding payment plans, refunds, adjustments, and outstanding balances.

Insurance and COB Coordination: Provide access to relevant insurance information, identify accounts requiring active coverage verification or Coordination of Benefits (COB) follow-ups, and ensure the billing team is available to address insurance-related discrepancies.

Operational Support: Designate authorized representatives to provide timely responses, necessary approvals, and guidance on matters requiring the Client's involvement, including billing disputes, insurance issues, and patient complaints.

Policies and Compliance: Provide applicable patient communication guidelines, financial policies, and necessary authorizations. The Client shall remain responsible for the accuracy of its records, final billing decisions, and compliance obligations applicable to its practice.

Payment Infrastructure: Maintain an approved and secure payment processing system, including merchant accounts and necessary third-party arrangements, for receiving and processing patient payments.

name: owner exclusions
text:
The Patient Help Desk services are limited to administrative patient communication, incoming call management, billing assistance, payment coordination, insurance information follow-ups, and Coordination of Benefits (COB) support as expressly defined in the agreed scope of work.

The following limitations and exclusions shall apply:

Clinical Services: Medical advice, clinical consultations, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, prescription management, and other clinical responsibilities are excluded. Clinical inquiries shall be referred to the Client's designated medical personnel.

Billing and Insurance Decisions: 24-7 Consultancy shall not independently modify patient balances, approve discounts, waive charges, authorize refunds, determine insurance benefits, or make final billing decisions without the Client's authorization.

Payment Processing: Patient payments shall be processed exclusively through Client-approved payment systems. 24-7 Consultancy shall not independently receive, retain, or manage patient funds. Payment gateway fees, merchant processing charges, and other third-party expenses are excluded from the service fee unless expressly agreed otherwise.

Insurance and COB Outcomes: 24-7 Consultancy shall assist with obtaining updated insurance information and COB-related patient follow-ups but shall not guarantee insurance eligibility, coverage approval, claim payment, or resolution of payer-related issues.

Debt Collection and Legal Matters: Formal debt collection activities requiring licensing, legal proceedings, litigation, and legal representation are excluded. Routine patient balance inquiries and payment assistance remain within the agreed scope.

Third-Party Dependencies: 24-7 Consultancy shall not be responsible for delays or unsuccessful outcomes caused by inaccurate information supplied by the Client, patient non-responsiveness, insurance companies, payment processors, or other independent third parties, except to the extent attributable to 24-7 Consultancy's own failure to perform its agreed responsibilities.

Service Availability and Additional Work: Services shall be provided during mutually agreed operating hours and within the approved staffing allocation. After-hours coverage, additional staffing, outbound campaigns unrelated to the agreed scope, and other additional services shall require prior written agreement.
